name: The Runner
source:
Toxic cyberpunk yuri interactive fiction about friendship, love and transhuman sports. How far should you go for those dear to you?

[From [url=https://borgarlover.itch.io/the-runner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部描绘不健康关系的赛博朋克百合互动小说，关于友情、爱情和超人类体育运动。为了珍视的人，你应该走多远？
